description: Manually reviewed, source-backed potential estimates. These are calibrated ceiling estimates, not exact source-published 0-99 grades. Includes source-reviewed potential estimates for the 2026 NHL Draft first round, calibrated from NHL Central Scouting ranks, production, role and NHL.com scouting analysis; these remain model-scale projections, not source-published numerical grades.

nhl-draft:2028:gordei-khotkov.rationale: 2010-born 6-foot-5 left-shot defender; 63 points in 56 U16/U17 games and 31 points in 19 Russia Cup games. Scouting describes high-end puck-moving and offensive activation, while noting defensive-awareness and consistency risk.

nhl-draft:2028:kane-cloutier.rationale: 2010-born forward selected first overall in the 2026 OHL Priority Selection; produced 58 points in 33 GTHL games. Scout projection is first-line forward with elite handling and creativity; strength and explosiveness remain development areas.

nhl-draft:2028:isak-alvudd.rationale: 2010-born Swedish forward ranked among the top European players of his age group; scouting reports highlight dynamic speed, high-level puck skill, fast processing and dual-threat offense.

nhl-draft:2028:lionel-dedial.rationale: 2010-born Swiss forward; 20 points in 14 Swiss U21 games and a 10-point international tournament. Reports emphasize an elite release, vision and puck protection; skating pace against adults remains a development question.

prospect:ANA:nikita-klepov.rationale: NHL Central Scouting No. 8 North American skater; led the OHL with 97 points in 67 games as a rookie and won OHL Rookie of the Year. NHL scouting describes high-end puck skill, hockey IQ, shooting and top-six upside.

ahl:11085.rationale: Age 22, second-round 2022 pick, two-time NCAA national champion with 35 points in 43 games in 2025-26. Current projection is bottom-six/depth rather than top-six; potential is capped accordingly.

ahl:4950.rationale: Age 36 veteran with 694 NHL games and a two-year contract through 2027-28. No remaining developmental upside is assumed; potential is set at the current-level baseline.

nhl:8486067.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 1 North American skater; elite hockey IQ and playmaking vision; 51 points in 35 NCAA games as an 18-year-old. Ceiling calibrated to franchise-level offensive impact.

nhl:8486103.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 1 international skater; 33 points in 43 SHL games as an 18-year-old, historic production for the league and age, with strong two-way reliability and franchise-wing projection.

prospect:VAN:caleb-malhotra.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: Complete two-way center; 84 points in 67 OHL games and 26 points in 15 playoff games, with top-line center projection and high-end hockey sense.

prospect:BUF:daxon-rudolph.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 5 North American skater; 78 points in 68 WHL games as a defenseman, strong two-way base, mobility and difficult-minutes projection.

nhl:8485957.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 2 international skater; played against men in Liiga and DEL, represented Latvia at Olympics and senior Worlds, with strong skating and mature two-way play.

prospect:CGY:carson-carels.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: Top-three North American defender; 73 points in 58 WHL games, heavy all-situations usage, mobility and efficient decisions under pressure.

nhl:8486087.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 2 North American skater; strong skating and three-zone competitiveness, with top-pair defense projection and 48 points in 45 OHL games.

nhl:8486025.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 4 international skater; 15 points in 42 SHL games at 18, plus major roles for Sweden at the World Juniors and senior World Championship.

prospect:SJS:keaton-verhoeff.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 4 North American skater; 20 points in 36 NCAA games as one of the youngest players in college hockey, with pro frame, mobility and two-way defense projection.

prospect:NSH:wyatt-cullen.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 13 North American skater; 45 points in 40 NTDP U18 games, elite skating and offensive creativity; middle-six projection with strength and defensive consistency still developing.

nhl:8486059.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 7 North American skater; competitive two-way center with strong pace and intelligence, productive in both USHL and NCAA competition at 17.

prospect:NJD:alexander-command.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 11 international skater; 44 points in 30 Swedish junior games, strong all-around competitiveness and detail; projected middle-six center.

prospect:NYI:malte-gustafsson.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 7 international skater; 6-foot-4 defender with exceptional skating, poise, first-pass ability and SHL experience; high-end defensive upside.

prospect:CBJ:oscar-hemming.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 11 North American skater; 6-foot-4 power forward with skating and forecheck tools, 8 points in 19 NCAA games; offensive consistency remains a development need.

nhl:8486033.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 15 North American skater; 62 points in 62 QMJHL games, power-forward size, scoring touch and inside game; projection moderated for skating and strength refinement.

prospect:LAK:elton-hermansson.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 5 international skater; 21 points in 38 Allsvenskan games as an under-18 player and 12 points in 7 games at the U18 Worlds, named tournament's best forward.

prospect:BUF:ilia-morozov.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 10 North American skater; 20 points in 36 NCAA games as one of the youngest players in the league, combining size, skating, puck skill and defensive discipline.

prospect:SJS:ryan-lin.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 16 North American skater; 57 points in 53 WHL games as a defenseman, elite hockey sense, dynamic skating and power-play quarterback projection.

nhl:8486091.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 20 North American skater; 104 points in 68 WHL games and 45 goals, with high-end finishing and offensive-zone instincts.

prospect:VAN:adam-novotny.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 14 North American skater; 65 points in 58 OHL games, pro-ready frame, strong motor and power-forward traits.

nhl:8486057.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft first-round scouting review: No. 19 international skater; 16 points in 9 games before season-ending injury, strong skating and finishing; ceiling tempered by limited recent sample and injury risk.

prospect:MTL:gleb-pugachyov.rationale: 2026 NHL Draft scouting review: No. 9 international skater; 24 points in 33 Russian junior games and 3 points in 13 KHL games at 18, with size, puck protection and agility.
